# Alameda Point Info (2009–2026)

> Community civic archive documenting the redevelopment, environmental cleanup, and reuse of the former Naval Air Station Alameda at Alameda Point, California.

## Overview
AlamedaPointInfo.com was launched in July 2009 by a small volunteer group of Alameda residents to provide transparent public access to city meetings, redevelopment documents, and news stories—years before the City of Alameda established its own dedicated webpage. The site was retired in 2026.

## Curated Archive & Timeline
- [Alameda Point Environmental Report Archive](https://alamedapointenviro.com/alameda-point-info-the-ultimate-resource-for-the-past-present-and-future-of-alameda-point/): Full historical timeline, key redevelopment documents, and maps maintained by Richard Bangert.
